svg.title: Collapsed lung project workflow, updated
svg.desc: Nine-step pipeline: segmentation, surface meshing, hilum anchor creation from the rings where airways and vessels enter the lung, registration, combined node correspondence and displacement field, inverse FEM pressure fitting, sequence generation and visualization.
